evidence: Hafnium silicate ﬁlms were grown in a cold-wall ﬂow-type ALD reactor on p-type Si(100) substrate in the temperature range of 150400°C. The pressure in the reactor was ﬁxed at about 0.5 Torr. ... Varying the water pulse time between 0.5 and 2 s had no effect on the growth rate. Ideal linear dependence was conﬁrmed by optimized pulse time and the constant growth rate was 1.2 Å/cycle at 200°C.
